universe.definition: market set from ironflow_bulk/candles_1h (the broad on-disk market universe)
universe.note: candles_1h market set (799) is broader than the liquidation-event coin set; coins without a liquidation event in a given hour enter as zero-intensity rows. This is consistent with the capped-sample design: the claim is about presence/intensity ordering, NOT a complete observed-liquidation census. The 15-coin combined panel (fclr_liq_combined_panel_20261115T181405Z.parquet, sha256 81a100d5...) is the narrow universe whose SUPPORTED findings (XSEC-004/005/006) this campaign tests for generalization.

decision.verdict_rule: SUPPORTED_GENERALIZATION iff narrow_universe_sign_reproduced AND CI95_excludes_null_favorable AND Holm_adjusted_primary_p < alpha_k; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED

results_recompute.method: independent stdlib recompute; direct arithmetic (no model refit)

agreement: eval and independent recompute agree: all_checks_match=true; same sign convention (baseline - candidate)/baseline
honest_caveats: Poisson-deviance materiality floor (2.0%) was NOT met on either arm (long -0.23%, short +0.71%). The SUPPORTED_GENERALIZATION verdict is driven by the cross-sectional rank-ordering association (rank-IC), not by a calibrated-magnitude improvement.
This is a broad-universe GENERALIZATION test of a cross-sectional ASSOCIATION. It is NOT a time-series forecast gate pass and NOT an observed-liquidation census (capped-sample feed; absence != zero).
No risk overlay is built or implied (RESEARCH_PROMPT.md section 9 overlay gate not satisfied by a cross-sectional association).
tractability_notes: Eval Step 10 (block bootstrap) was corrected to the prereg-specified unit (resample complete UTC time blocks jointly across coins) instead of resampling coins over the 1.7M-row pooled panel; the coin-pooled form was computationally intractable and did not match the prereg method.

Eval Step 11 (placebo/permutation null) uses precomputed per-block ordinal rank vectors and an O(n) Pearson correlation of the fixed actual ranks against a shuffled copy of the pred ranks per replicate. This is numerically identical to re-running spearman_rank_ic on a shuffled prediction vector (Spearman = Pearson of ranks) and preserves N=1000 permutations; it only removes per-replicate sorting so the heavy evaluation is tractable in pure Python.

Neither correction touches the headline cross-sectional rank-IC (computed in the untouched Step 9) nor the frozen prereg design (train_frac, purge, 168h blocks, horizon, Holm family, alpha_k, materiality floor).
nulls_preserved: materiality null preserved on both arms; verdict reported honestly per the frozen rule
software: stdlib + pyarrow (parquet read only); numpy/pandas/scipy not used in eval or recompute
